sentences.en: Algeria has reception centers for migrants from Mali and Syria.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚设有收容来自马里和叙利亚移居者的接待中心。

sentences.en: There are many migrant farm-worker children at our school.
sentences.zh: 我们学校有很多来自农场工人的移居者孩子。

sentences.en: Many migrants travel from Greece, through the Balkans, to Western Europe.
sentences.zh: 许多移居者从希腊穿过巴尔干地区前往西欧。
